subject: Follow-up: Trial kickoff & environment decision for Horizon Health POC
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.j@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap & next steps — Horizon Health trial environment options

Claire — great call this morning. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before kickoff.

Summary of customer goals (from today):
- Validate Redwood for clinical note summarization and extraction workflows against a subset of patient notes (de-identified).
- Measure latency at 99th percentile under typical clinician load (aim <= 300ms per request).
- Confirm data controls and audit logging for PHI handling (SOC 2 compatible; plan to keep data in VPC if required).

Environment options discussed (pros/cons):
1) Hosted trial (Redwood Hosted API)
   - Fast to stand up, no infra work on your side. Good for early model and prompt iteration.
   - Limitation: data will transit Redwood's hosted environment; acceptable only for de-identified data.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity in Redwood Dedicated)
   - Isolated GPU pool, predictable throughput, easier to benchmark. Redwood retains control plane; can provide access logs.
   - Middle ground for teams who want performance isolation but no VPC networking.
3) VPC trial (Private deployment into your AWS VPC)
   - Full network isolation, data never leaves your VPC. Requires firewall rules, IAM role for deployment, and a short infra setup window (2–3 business days).

Our recommendation (given security ask): proceed with a short VPC-based trial for evaluation of PHI controls and the 99p latency target. If your security team prefers to avoid VPC setup, we can run an initial hosted trial with strictly de-identified data while we prepare the VPC.

Proposed success criteria (we'll measure during the POC):
- Functional: 90%+ extraction accuracy on the provided validation set (per your labeling guidance).
- Performance: 99th percentile latency <= 300ms for 128-token requests at target concurrency of 20 rps.
- Security/compliance: audit logs available and E2E data residency verified for VPC trial.

Immediate asks from Horizon Health:
- Confirm preferred environment (Hosted / Dedicated sandbox / VPC) by EOD Monday 7/21.
- If VPC: provide a short list of CIDR ranges and an AWS account ID for the deployment role.
- Send the validation dataset link (or sample of 200 de-identified notes) for model acceptance testing.

Attachments: attached a starter SOW (sow_draft_v1.pdf) and a network checklist (network_requirements.xlsx).

Next steps (owners):
- Aditya: schedule technical kickoff (target week of 7/28) and produce a mutual action plan.
- Laura: scope environment build and handoff to Rishi for VPC setup if selected.
- Rishi: estimate infra/setup time and confirm firewall rules needed.

I'll follow up with a calendar invite after I hear your environment preference.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Claire Jensen <claire.j@horizonhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: eng@horizonhealth.com
Date: 2025-07-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Horizon Health trial environment options

Thanks Aditya — useful summary. We had a quick security sync and the short answer: we need VPC for any POC that touches real PHI. We'd prefer to run a VPC-based trial. A few clarifications:
- We'll provide a de-identified 200-note sample this week for initial accuracy checks while infra is set up.
- Our network team needs: AWS account ID (will give you a role ARN to assume), list of public IPs you'll use, and the recommended inbound ports.
- Timeline: we can have network approvals by 7/24 if there's no major ask from Redwood.

Can you confirm if Redwood provides a CloudFormation template or similar for the VPC deployment? Also please confirm expected downtime window and whether we need to open access to any internal services.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Claire
Claire Jensen
Director, Clinical AI
Horizon Health
claire.j@horizonhealth.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Claire Jensen <claire.j@horizonhealth.com>
Date: 2025-07-21T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Horizon Health trial environment options

Claire/Aditya — we can support a VPC deployment. Quick notes from infra:
- We have a deployable CloudFormation/Terraform module for the private agent that we can push into your account. I'll share the template link in a follow-up.
- Estimated setup time: 1–2 business days once the role and CIDRs are provided and security group rules are confirmed.
- Ports required: outbound 443 to our control plane (for metrics and orchestrator) and inbound only on the internal ENI from your management subnet. We can lock down to /32 where needed.
- We will not persist raw notes outside of the instance; logging is configurable to either S3 in your account or KMS-encrypted logs forwarded to our audit pipeline upon request.

Action items from Redwood infra:
- Rishi: share CF/Terraform module and a short install runbook (by 7/22).
- Laura: draft the environment build plan and resource estimate (by 7/23).

I've attached the network_requirements.xlsx here for Claire's team to fill in. [Attachment: network_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

—Rishi

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Claire Jensen <claire.j@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-07-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps — Horizon Health trial environment options

Claire — thanks, confirmed: Horizon Health will proceed with a VPC trial. Summary of agreements and next steps below (so we can lock the mutual action plan):

Decisions & owners:
- Environment: VPC trial in Horizon AWS account. Owner: Horizon (network) + Rishi (Redwood infra).
- Success criteria: accuracy target 90%+, 99p latency <= 300ms at 20 rps. Owner: Aditya + Claire for acceptance testing.
- Data/sample exchange: Horizon to upload 200 de-identified notes to the shared Drive link by 7/23.

Deliverables & timeline:
- 7/22 (today): Rishi to post CF/Terraform module & runbook (link: https://redwoodinference.app/drive/POC-HZ-114).
- 7/23: Horizon to provide account ID, CIDR ranges and upload sample (network_requirements.xlsx completed).
- 7/24–7/25: Infra deploy window (target) and smoke tests.
- 7/28: Technical kickoff and start of scoring/benchmarking run (2-week window for primary eval).

I'll send a calendar invite for the 7/28 kickoff and share a living mutual action plan doc (https://docs.google.com/document/d/1X_POC-success-criteria) for owners to edit.

If anyone wants to shift to Dedicated sandbox instead of VPC after the initial run, we can discuss — but per security it's clear VPC is the path for now.

Thanks all — I'll loop in CS and our security PM when we confirm the account ID.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

[Attachment: sow_draft_v1.pdf (PDF)]
